checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Video is square 640x640, not 16:9 (agent disclosed this).

must.item: Lighthouse stripes, rocky coast, composition match first picture
must.why: Frames match the first image closely, though the camera drifts and the lighthouse shifts left.

must.item: Watercolor appearance and dusk lighting remain throughout
must.why: The image is a photorealistic sunset, not watercolor. Dusk lighting does persist.

must.item: Waves move against rocks and beam sweeps across the water
must.why: Waves move, but there is no visible beam sweeping across the water, only a glowing lamp.

must.item: No added writing or audible sound
must.why: No text is visible. The video was requested silent.

faults.what: Output is square, not the requested wide/16:9 shape
No visible lighthouse beam sweeping across the water
Style is photorealistic, not watercolor as the must-have expects (the first picture was never watercolor)
Slow camera drift and zoom shifts the framing, lighthouse moves left

summary: The clip is a square, photoreal sunset lighthouse with moving waves that matches the source picture, but it has no visible sweeping beam and is not wide 16:9.
